name: com.sipvlib.ads
description: A mediation-agnostic facade (AdsManager/AdsPlatformController) over AdMob, AppLovin MAX, and Unity LevelPlay ad networks, with config-driven rate-limiting, unlock-condition gating, and reward-fraud checks, where each network's real SDK calls are conditionally compiled via versionDefines based on installed ad SDK packages.

name: com.sipvlib.anticheat
description: Server-verified game time (GameTime, fetched from a fallback chain of public time APIs instead of the device clock) plus lightweight heuristic runtime integrity checks (IntegrityChecker: debugger, root/jailbreak, emulator, and clock-tamper detection).

name: com.sipvlib.config
description: A ScriptableObject-based game config system (GameConfig/ConfigManager/ConfigRoot) supporting Local/Resources/Addressable/RemoteConfig-backed data sources, with an optional Odin Inspector-powered editor tool (MasterWindow) for authoring configs.

name: com.sipvlib.debugging
description: Log wrapper for SiPVLib, toggleable via the LOGGING_DISABLE scripting define symbol.

name: com.sipvlib.event
description: A lightweight, thread-safe string/type-keyed pub/sub event bus for Unity with MonoBehaviour extension methods and automatic listener cleanup on destroy.

name: com.sipvlib.extras.components
description: Drop-in MonoBehaviour components used across SiPVLib games: ButtonHandler (tap + repeating hold with SFX and haptics), TMPEffect (SDF outline/shadow plus vertex-colour gradient for TextMeshPro, no extra draw calls), EmptyGraphic (raycast target with zero draw cost), SafeArea (notch-aware RectTransform driver), BackgroundCapture (flattens the render behind it into a RenderTexture to cut UI overdraw), plus SortingLayerSetter, AspectRatioFitterPlus and ScreenOrientationLock.

name: com.sipvlib.pool
description: Object pooling for prefabs (bullets, VFX, UI views, enemies) behind a single static PoolManager facade, with per-prefab prewarm/max-size/auto-cleanup tuning via a PoolConfig asset.

name: com.sipvlib.providers
description: Editor window and registry for managing third-party providers (ad networks, storage backends) used by SiPVLib. Installs/removes provider packages via Package Manager and toggles the scripting defines that gate each provider's code, so unused SDKs never end up in a build.

name: com.sipvlib.shop
description: A store-agnostic in-game shop layer (ShopManager/IShopManager) on top of Unity IAP v5, supporting IAP, currency-conversion, rewarded-ad, and free shop items with purchase/restore orchestration, reward granting, and event broadcasting.

name: com.sipvlib.sound
description: A central SoundManager for music, SFX, and ambience playback with AudioMixer channel volume/mute control, ConfigSoundGroup-based clip authoring, and UserDataManager-backed persistence of user volume settings.

name: com.sipvlib.tutorial
description: A node-graph-based in-game tutorial/onboarding sequencing system (TutorialManager/TutorialConfig) with pluggable actions (force-touch, show/hide view, invoke/listen/wait-for events, checkpoints) and branch conditions (UserData, view/UI state, tutorial active/completed), plus an optional Odin-powered Tutorial Graph editor window for authoring flows visually.

name: com.sipvlib.ui
description: Screen/Window/Popup/Top/Tutorial UI view management behind a single UIManager facade, with views pooled via SiPV.Pool, tuned via SiPV.Config (ViewConfig), and lifecycle (Show/Hide/Complete) broadcasts over SiPV.Event.

name: com.sipvlib.userdata
description: A player save-data layer behind one facade (UserDataManager), persisted through pluggable IStorageProviders (PlayerPrefs/LocalFile/Firestore), with versioned schemas, automatic migration, opt-in write batching for hot-path counters, and an optional Odin Inspector-powered editor window for inspecting/editing saved data.

name: com.sipvlib.utilities
description: General-purpose singleton base classes (Singleton, MonoSingleton), extension methods for classes/longs/GameObjects, and misc utilities (retry backoff, sub-asset attribute) used across SiPVLib.

name: com.sipvlib.vibrate
description: A haptic feedback facade (VibrateManager) with config-driven presets, a persisted on/off switch, and a UI pointer-interaction component, with optional integration with the paid Solo MOST_IN_ONE Haptic Feedback Asset Store plugin.
